# OpenVibe.Tips

> Support the people you watch: tips and goals, paid messages read out on stream, and alert overlays, all on the OpenVibe network's own ledger. OpenVibe.Tips is not open yet; it launches with the network's Billing cutover. Tipping with Vibes already works on OpenVibe.Live.

## Today

- [OpenVibe.Live](https://openvibe.live/): live streaming, where tips with Vibes work now
- [OpenVibe.Network](https://openvibe.network/): one OpenVibe account for every site, and the OpenCoins wallet

## Not open yet

- [OpenVibe.VIP](https://openvibe.vip/): creator memberships and perks, launching with OpenVibe.Tips
